question: Which of the following is an ethanoic acid?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Acetic acid".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ethanoic acid **is also called acetic acid and its chemical formula is **CH₃COOH.**
 
• It belongs to a group o**f carboxylic acids.**
 
• **Characteristics:** 
 
 
• Acidic
 
• colorless liquid
 
• organic compound
 
 
 
• After adding 5-6% of acetic acid in water it becomes vinegar and **vinegar** is used in pickles as a preservative.
 
• **Uses **of ethanoic acid:
 
 
• as a solvent.
 
• used in the production of vinegar, synthetic polymers, etc.
 
• as an antifungal agent.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amino acid - **organic compounds, that contain both amino and carboxylic acid groups.

 
 
• These are used by our bodies to make proteins.
 
• Our body needs **20 types of different amino acids**.** Nine **of these are called **essential amino acids **which we have to consume throughout our diet.
 
 
 
• ​**Formic acid -** It is also called methanoic acid having the chemical formula **HCOOH**.
 
 
• It is found in **red ants.**
 
• It is used as a **preservative** in livestock feed.
 
• used in the **fuel cells.**
 
 
 
• **Methyl alcohol** is known as methanol also.
 
 
• Chemical formula - **CH₃OH**
 
• Light, volatile, colorless, flammable.
